newsitem.title: MEXICO: GEUPEC TO PAY AZTECA SHARES AS DIVIDEND.
newsitem.headline: GEUPEC TO PAY AZTECA SHARES AS DIVIDEND.

text.p: Mexican soft-drinks bottler Grupo Embotelladoras Unidas (Geupec) said on Wednesday it would pay a dividend in the form of shares in Mexican television network TV Azteca.
TV Azteca will price a global initial public offering on Thursday. Price estimates by the underwriters show proceeds from the IPO could total more than $600 million.
A Geupec official told Reuters in a recent interview that Geupec holds 30.26 million of Azteca's privately held shares.
"Each shareholder in Geupec will receive 0.55197312672 shares in TV Azteca" for each outstanding share in the bottler, the company said in a report to the Mexican Stock Exchange.

Geupec added that, if TV Azteca Ordinary Participation Certificates (CPOs) were trading on the Mexican bourse by August 15, they would pay a dividend of 0.18399104224 CPO for each outstanding share in the bottler.
Each CPO represents one series A share plus one series D-A share and one series D-L share.
"The shares will be subject to a commitment not to be sold within six months," the Geupec statement said.
((--Tomas de la Rosa, Mexico City newsroom +525 728-7912))
